props.subhead: Visit our Aftermarket Location for all of your truck and trailer repair needs. We specialize in truck equipment repair, roll off cable repair, hydraulic truck equipment repair and much more.

image.alt: The Sun State aftermarket shop — photograph to be supplied

props.text:
At Sun State, we want to help all our customers find the equipment that's right for them. If you need to customize or alter your truck or trailer to fit your specific needs, we're here to assist you.

Our fabrication and welding shop handles frame alterations, wheelbase changes, body wraps and liftgate repairs, while our aftermarket parts counter stocks the body, hoist, trailer and A/C lines that keep specialized equipment working. Whether you run a single vocational truck or a mixed fleet of all makes, the work is done by technicians who build this equipment every day.

items.title: All makes trailer parts & service
items.body: Everything you need for your trailer is in one place. We repair aluminum and fiberglass reinforced plywood, repair or replace king pins and landing gear, and install accessories including underbody skirts, vents, side doors and tire carriers, all in dedicated trailer repair bays.

items.title: Liftgates, start to finish
items.body: We cover all your trailer needs down to the last detail, including comprehensive care for your liftgates: new installations, remounts, warranty services and parts replacements.

items.q: What does the Sun State Aftermarket department do?
items.a: We handle aftermarket modifications and alterations for trucks, trailers and buses, specializing in truck equipment repair, roll off cable repair and hydraulic truck equipment repair, along with body installations, liftgates, frame modifications and all-makes trailer parts and service.

items.q: Do you install truck bodies on all makes?
items.a: Yes. We perform all-makes new or used body installations and swaps including van, reefer, dump, flatbed, tank and roll-off hoist bodies.

items.q: Can you modify a truck frame without voiding the factory warranty?
items.a: Yes. Our frame work includes shortening and lengthening, double single rails, driveline work and Huck bolt replacement to maintain factory warranty on all makes.

items.q: Do you clean DPFs and DOCs?
items.a: Yes. We clean and bake diesel particulate filters and diesel oxidation catalysts at our aftermarket facility.

items.q: Which aftermarket parts lines do you carry?
items.a: We stock Godwin dump body parts, Galbreath roll-off hoist and hooklift parts, Hyundai and all-makes trailer parts, Capacity yard tractor parts and warranty, E-Z Ride and Silent Drive lift axle parts, and A/C parts from Carrier, MCC, ACT, Transair and Busair.

items.q: Where is the Aftermarket location and when is it open?
items.a: Sun State Aftermarket Parts is at 7105 East 6th Ave, Tampa, FL 33619, open 7 AM to 4 PM Monday through Friday, with in-store shopping, in-store pickup and delivery. Call (813) 627-3282.

items.q: Do you work on trailers as well as trucks?
items.a: Yes. All-makes trailer parts and service includes repairing aluminum and fiberglass reinforced plywood, repairing or replacing king pins and landing gear, and accessory installation such as underbody skirts, vents, side doors and tire carriers, in dedicated trailer repair bays.

values.heading: Tell us what the truck has to do.
values.body: Bring us the body, hoist, liftgate or frame change you need and we'll tell you what it takes, what it costs and how long the unit will be down.
